notes: Base HA5-12G model (BNC-only), not the -T or -T-ST fiber variants which add a 12G-SDI Fiber Output (LC or ST connector) alongside the same BNC I/O. Specs drawn from AJA's official HA5-12G Mini-Converter Manual v1.9 and matching AJA spec sheet (aja.com/products/ha5-12g and /spec-sheet.pdf), cross-checked against the manufacturer product page. HDMI input grade set to hdmi-2.0 per manual (HDMI v2.0b). SDI outputs graded sdi-12g per manual ("1x 12G-SDI BNC, SMPTE 259/292/424/2081/2082" x2, mirrored). Audio outputs are embedded in the SDI signal (not a separate physical connector) per block diagram, so not listed as a discrete port. USB connector sub-type not explicitly named in AJA docs (only "USB port"); mapped to usb-micro as AJA's standard mini-converter USB connector, medium-confidence inference noted above. No USB data-speed grade given, so grade omitted per instructions. Desktop mini-converter (4.6 x 4.02 x 0.9 in / 116.8 x 102.1 x 22.9 mm) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: HDMI Input
ports.note: HDMI Type A connector, HDMI v2.0b, supports up to 4K/UltraHD 60p

ports.name: SDI Output 2
ports.note: Mirrored 12G-SDI distribution amplifier output, same spec as SDI Output 1

ports.name: USB Port
ports.note: Used with supplied cable and AJA Mini-Config software for setup/monitoring; exact USB connector sub-type (Micro-B) not explicitly stated in AJA documentation, inferred from AJA mini-converter family convention. No data grade stated, omitted.

ports.name: DC Power Input
ports.note: 5-16VDC regulated, ~11-12W; universal AC-DC power supply (DWP-U-R1) included, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz
